sentences.text: In Mainz-Bingen, 594 reports over ten years put its main time as February to April and June to October, peaking in July and August.
It has been recorded eating English Ivy.
It has been recorded visiting the flowers of Common Lilac, Hemp Agrimony, Creeping Thistle, common dandelion, English Ivy, cherry laurel, and Garlic Mustard.
